old_findings.note: 80 of the 92 revert-reason copy loops now fold to `revert with 'MATH64_ADD_OVERFLOW'` etc. (118 quoted reverts). 12 loops remain where the reason is one of two constant strings at a join (EXECUTE_PAYMENT_NUM/TIME, 6 per execute function).

removeBudget/setBudget now print `while uint64(block.timestamp) > uint64(stor[s].field_64): if not uint64(t): revert 'FINANCE_COMPLETE_TRANSITION'`, and the budget writes and SetBudget once after the loop (logs 3 -> 1).
payment loop still `while True` with _nextPaymentTime's arms in the exit tests (2944-2955 and the 2 other copies).

regressions.decompiled: mem[_908 + 320] = 0x08c379a0... ; mem[_908 + 324] = 32 ; ... while idx < _1633: mem[idx + mem[64] + 68] = mem[_1635 + idx] ... revert with memory from mem[64] len floor32(_1632) + 100

regressions.issue: Where the free-memory pointer differs between the outer arms (_908 + 320 vs _908 + 192), the Error(string) header is now written relative to `_908` but the copy loop and the revert still use `mem[64]`, so the revert is no longer recognized as `Error(string reason)` and shows as a raw memory range. Where the pointer is the same in both arms (2982) the Error form is kept.
regressions.rule: When mem[64] at a join is a phi of base + k_i, express the writes after the join in the same terms as the arms (or keep the arms mem[64]-relative), so that the Error(string) payload is matched on the join's buffer.

improvements: Revert reasons folded to constant strings (Error(string) copy lines 340 -> 11, whiles 139 -> 39); the period-transition loop reads as in the source everywhere (`while timestamp > endTime: if not t: return 0 / revert`), with the duplicated tails of removeBudget/setBudget gone; NewTransaction logs fully decoded (`reference=Array(len=0, data='')`); hasPermission's bytes argument decoded as `Array(len=64, data=...)`; SafeMath.sub helper added and used (`SafeMath.sub(transactionsNextIndex, 1)`); guard-first reverts; `mem[_179] == 1` after the token call -> `ext_call.return_data[0] == 1`; recoverToVault's balance call named `balanceOf`; P6 (141) gone; 2,189 fewer lines.
notes: Reviewed by structure (6.8k-line diff): per-function multisets of calls, logs, storage writes, reverts and loops compared after normalizing variable numbers; every difference is a folded revert string, the transition-loop rewrite, a decoded log/argument or hex padding. transferToVault only moved in the text. recoverToVault's join now writes `transaction[concat(mem[0])].field_1088` (P4, 2 lines) where the old text had `stor[_208 + 4].field_64` with `_208 = sha3(id, 6)`: mapping named, key less direct (neutral). The `_newPeriod` code is still printed in both arms of `if not stor[s + 1]` in each transition loop (P12, 11 loops). Dead `mem[0]` save/restore pairs reduced 18 -> 6 (P8).
summary: Large improvement: revert strings folded, the transition loop unrotated with single tails, logs and ACL arguments decoded; one low regression where 4 one-of-two-string revert sites (8 lines) per execute function lost their Error(string) form. The payment loop is still `while True`.
